title: BACEN - Active credit cards
description: Active credit cards in Brazil, in millions (BACEN SGS 25149, annual). The series was discontinued after 2022; 2022 is the last published year.

panels.title: Active cards (latest year)
panels.description: Active credit cards in the latest year in range, in millions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS active_cards
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Year-over-year change (latest year)
panels.description: Active cards in the latest year in range vs the previous year (the previous year may fall outside the range).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    value::DOUBLE AS value,
    lag(value::DOUBLE) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt) AS prev_value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT value / nullif(prev_value, 0) - 1 AS yoy_change
FROM d
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY ref_dt DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: CAGR in range
panels.description: Compound annual growth rate of active cards from the first to the last year in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pow(
    arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE / nullif(arg_min(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE, 0),
    1 / nullif(year(max(ref_dt)) - year(min(ref_dt)), 0)
  ) - 1 AS cagr
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest year
panels.description: Most recent year with data in range. The series was discontinued after 2022.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(ref_dt), '%Y') AS latest_year
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Active credit cards per year
panels.description: Active credit cards at each year, in millions (SGS 25149).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  strftime(ref_dt, '%Y') AS year,
  value::DOUBLE AS "Active cards"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY ref_dt

panels.title: Year-over-year change
panels.description: Active cards vs the previous year, in percent.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    value::DOUBLE AS value,
    lag(value::DOUBLE) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt) AS prev_value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  strftime(ref_dt, '%Y') AS year,
  value / nullif(prev_value, 0) - 1 AS "YoY change"
FROM d
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND prev_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ref_dt

panels.title: Net cards added per year
panels.description: Active cards minus the previous year's, in millions.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    value::DOUBLE AS value,
    lag(value::DOUBLE) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt) AS prev_value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  strftime(ref_dt, '%Y') AS year,
  value - prev_value AS "Net cards added"
FROM d
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND prev_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ref_dt

panels.title: Growth since start of range
panels.description: Active cards relative to the first year in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  value::DOUBLE / nullif(first_value(value::DOUBLE) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt), 0) - 1 AS "Growth since start"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Active cards per year
panels.description: Active cards (millions), change vs the previous year and growth since the first year in range. The series was discontinued after 2022.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    value::DOUBLE AS value,
    lag(value::DOUBLE) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt) AS prev_value,
    blocked
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_cards/yearly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  strftime(ref_dt, '%Y') AS year,
  value AS cards_millions,
  value - prev_value AS change_millions,
  value / nullif(prev_value, 0) - 1 AS change_pct,
  value / nullif(first_value(value) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt), 0) - 1 AS growth_since_start,
  blocked
FROM d
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY ref_dt DESC
